tagline.zh: 從一張舊手機照片到一顆不癒合的小丘疹
tagline.en: From an old phone photo to a small lesion that will not heal

desc.zh: 問演變、公平比較照片、畫切片邊界、寫病理申請單。外觀不是組織結果。
desc.en: Ask about evolution, compare photographs fairly, mark the biopsy margins, write the pathology request. Appearance is not histology.

desc.zh: 標準化攝影、切片器械、檢體標籤、追蹤電話。沒有尺的照片不算照片。
desc.en: Standardised photography, the biopsy tray, specimen labels, the follow-up calls. A photo without a ruler is not a photo.

about.zh: 皮膚科主治，皮膚鏡掛在脖子上，口袋裡一捲尺貼紙。每一個病灶她只問一句：「它變了嗎？」
about.en: Dermatologist with a dermatoscope on a lanyard and a roll of ruler stickers in her pocket. Of every lesion she asks one thing: 'Has it changed?'

about.zh: 攝影區和治療室都是她的。同一個距離、同一個光線、同一把尺，三年後的照片才比得了。
about.en: Runs the photo station and the procedure room. Same distance, same light, same ruler, so that the photo three years from now can be compared.

about.zh: 48 歲市場攤商，小腿一顆色素斑半年來變大。舊手機裡有一張去年夏天的照片，因為那天穿了新涼鞋。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 48-year-old market stallholder with a pigmented spot on her calf that has grown over six months. Her old phone holds a photo from last summer, taken because of new sandals. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 72 歲，鼻翼一顆小丘疹半年來反覆出血結痂，堅信是刮鬍子刮到。孫子逼他來的。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 72-year-old with a small papule on the side of his nose that has bled and crusted repeatedly for six months. Certain it is a shaving cut. His grandson made him come. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 59 歲，腎移植八年，做了三十年工地。耳廓上一顆硬硬的結節六週內變大、會痛。想把移植藥停掉「免得再長」。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 59-year-old eight years after a kidney transplant, thirty years on building sites. A hard nodule on his ear has grown and become painful within six weeks. Wants to stop his transplant drugs 'so nothing else grows'. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 25 歲研究生，一週前因為泌尿道感染開始吃抗生素，昨天全身起疹，今天發燒、嘴巴破、眼睛痛。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 25-year-old postgraduate who started an antibiotic for a urinary infection a week ago, broke out in a rash yesterday, and today has a fever, mouth ulcers and sore eyes. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 急診打來會診「一個皮疹」。皮膚科最怕的就是「只是一個皮疹」。
about.en: The ER calling about 'a rash'. The phrase dermatology fears most is 'just a rash'.

about.zh: 病理科收檢體的人。申請單少一格，他會傳訊息來要。
about.en: Receives the specimens in pathology. One missing box on the request form and he messages you for it.

plain.zh: 一支放大加偏光的小鏡子，看得到皮膚表面底下的色素結構和血管。它提示風險，不能取代組織。
plain.en: A small magnifier with polarised light that shows pigment structures and vessels beneath the skin surface. It signals risk; it does not replace tissue.

plain.zh: 皮膚上任何一塊深色的斑或痣。大多數無害，重點不是大小，是它有沒有在變。
plain.en: Any dark spot or mole on the skin. Most are harmless; what matters is not the size but whether it is changing.

plain.zh: 病灶隨時間改變：變大、變色、邊緣變不規則、開始癢或流血。這是最重要的一個警訊。
plain.en: A lesion changing over time: bigger, different colour, irregular edge, itching or bleeding. The single most important warning sign.

plain.zh: 同一個距離、同一個光線、旁邊放一把尺。沒有尺的兩張照片不能公平比較。
plain.en: Same distance, same light, a ruler beside the lesion. Two photos without a ruler cannot be compared fairly.

plain.zh: 局部麻醉後取一小塊皮膚送病理。取哪裡、取多深、邊界怎麼標，決定報告能不能回答問題。
plain.en: Removing a small piece of skin under local anaesthetic for pathology. Where, how deep and how the margins are marked decide whether the report can answer the question.

plain.zh: 在顯微鏡下看到組織才算確診。外觀再典型，也只是「像」。
plain.en: A diagnosis made by seeing the tissue under the microscope. However typical the appearance, it is only 'looks like' until then.

plain.zh: 最常見的皮膚癌，長得慢、很少轉移，但會在原地一直破壞。常見的樣子：一顆反覆出血結痂、邊緣像珍珠的小丘疹。
plain.en: The commonest skin cancer: slow-growing, rarely spreading, but relentlessly destructive where it sits. Classic look: a small papule that bleeds and crusts again and again, with a pearly edge.

plain.zh: 病灶邊緣像半透明的小珍珠，上面有細細的血管。看到它要想到基底細胞癌，但仍要切片。
plain.en: A translucent, pearl-like rim with fine vessels across it. Think basal cell carcinoma when you see it, but still biopsy.

plain.zh: 鼻翼、眼瞼、嘴唇這種沒有東西支撐的邊緣。這裡的病灶，治療計畫要同時想功能和外觀。
plain.en: Edges with nothing behind them, such as the nostril rim, eyelid or lip. A lesion here needs a plan that considers function and appearance together.

plain.zh: 皮膚天然的張力方向。順著皮紋切，疤痕最細；逆著切，疤痕會張開。
plain.en: The skin's natural lines of tension. Cut along them and the scar is finest; cut across them and it spreads.

plain.zh: 把病灶連同邊界切成一個兩頭尖的橄欖形，方便縫合不起皺。長軸要順著皮紋。
plain.en: Removing the lesion with its margin as a pointed-ends ellipse so the wound closes flat. The long axis follows the skin tension lines.

plain.zh: 移植後為了保護器官而壓低免疫系統。代價是皮膚癌風險大幅上升，而且長得更快、更凶。
plain.en: Holding the immune system down after a transplant to protect the organ. The price is a much higher risk of skin cancer, which also grows faster and behaves worse.

plain.zh: 一顆硬硬的、表面粗糙結痂的突起。在免疫抑制又長期日曬的人身上，快速變大就是警訊。
plain.en: A firm, rough, crusted bump. In someone immunosuppressed with decades of sun, rapid growth is the warning.

term.zh: 嚴重皮膚藥物不良反應

plain.zh: 藥物引起的全身性皮膚反應，可能起水泡、皮膚剝離、黏膜潰爛、發燒。會致命，要立刻停藥並升級照護。
plain.en: A drug-induced reaction across the whole skin: blisters, peeling, ulcerated mucosa, fever. It can kill; the drug stops at once and care escalates.

plain.zh: 嘴巴、眼睛、生殖器內側的濕潤表面。皮疹加黏膜受累，就不是「只是一個皮疹」。
plain.en: The moist linings of the mouth, eyes and genitals. A rash plus mucosal involvement is never 'just a rash'.

text.zh: 莊主治脖子上那支。放大十倍、偏光，看色素網、小球、血管。皮膚鏡的照片也要標準化，才能和下次比。
text.en: The one around Dr Chuang's neck. Ten times magnification, polarised light, for pigment networks, globules and vessels. Dermoscopy images are standardised too, so they can be compared next time.

text.zh: 固定的燈、固定的距離標記、貼在病灶旁邊的尺。小婷的規矩：先拍全景定位，再拍近景，再拍皮膚鏡。
text.en: Fixed lights, a fixed distance mark, a ruler stuck beside the lesion. Nurse Ting's rule: overview for location first, then close-up, then dermoscopy.

text.zh: 標記筆、尺、消毒、局麻、切片工具、縫線、檢體罐、固定液。先畫邊界、再拍照、再消毒，順序不能反。
text.en: Marker, ruler, antiseptic, local anaesthetic, biopsy instruments, sutures, specimen pot, fixative. Mark the margins, photograph, then prep; never the other way round.

text.zh: 臨床照片、皮膚鏡影像、必要時的影像檢查都在這裡。先核對姓名日期，再比較。比較之前先問：拍攝條件一樣嗎？
text.en: Clinical photos, dermoscopy images and any imaging studies live here. Name and date first, then compare. And before comparing: were the conditions the same?

text.zh: 皮膚科很少看監視器，直到有人說「只是一個皮疹」加上發燒。那時候體溫和血壓比皮疹本身更重要。
text.en: Dermatology rarely watches a monitor, until someone says 'just a rash' and adds a fever. Then temperature and blood pressure matter more than the rash itself.

text.zh: 固定液裡一小塊帶著邊界標記的皮膚，罐身是阿香的雙識別，申請單附了部位圖和兩張照片。病理回來之前，它是整個問題的答案。
text.en: A small piece of skin with its margin marks in fixative, the pot carrying Ms Hsiang's two identifiers, the form carrying a site diagram and two photos. Until pathology returns, it holds the whole answer.

text.zh: 大小不是唯一條件。一顆小的但在變的病灶，比一顆大的但十年沒變的病灶更需要注意。問演變，公平比較照片，然後決定。
text.en: Size is not the only criterion. A small lesion that is changing needs more attention than a large one unchanged for ten years. Ask about evolution, compare photos fairly, then decide.

text.zh: 珍珠樣邊緣、不規則色素、快速變大的角化結節，都只是「像」。治療計畫建立在病理確認之上，不建立在直徑之上。
text.en: A pearly border, irregular pigment, a fast-growing keratotic nodule: all of them are only 'looks like'. Treatment plans rest on histological confirmation, not on a diameter.

note.zh: 晨會：今天的門診與切片

guide.en: Check today's list at the board

lines.zh: 早。今天門診四十五個，兩個切片，下午一個移植追蹤。尺貼紙一人一捲，照片沒有尺就不要拍。
lines.en: Morning. Forty-five in clinic, two biopsies, a transplant follow-up this afternoon. One roll of ruler stickers each; no ruler, no photo.

lines.zh: 第一位阿香，小腿色素斑半年變大。
lines.en: First is Ms Hsiang, a calf lesion growing over six months.

lines.zh: 「變大」是她說的。你等一下要做的，是讓照片說。
lines.en: 'Growing' is her word. Your job shortly is to let the photographs say it.

guide.en: Before clinic: where is the dermatoscope?

lines.zh: 每天開診前三件事：皮膚鏡充飽、攝影區燈開、尺貼紙補滿。先找到皮膚鏡。
lines.en: Three things before every clinic: dermatoscope charged, photo-station lights on, ruler stickers restocked. Find the dermatoscope first.

q.en: Find the dermatoscope in the clinic

post.zh: 充飽了。鏡頭擦過。今天它會很忙。
post.en: Fully charged, lens cleaned. It will be busy today.

guide.en: Call Ms Hsiang into the room

lines.zh: 醫師，這顆痣我從小就有，可是半年來好像變大了。我手機裡有去年夏天的照片，因為那天穿新涼鞋。
lines.en: Doctor, I have had this mole since I was small, but it seems bigger these six months. I have a photo from last summer on my phone, because of my new sandals.

lines.zh: 顏色有變嗎？邊緣？會癢或流血嗎？
lines.en: Has the colour changed? The edge? Any itching or bleeding?

lines.zh: 顏色好像深淺不一了。邊邊……不像以前那麼圓。
lines.en: The colour seems uneven now. The edge... is not as round as it used to be.

lines.zh: 色素斑只問一句：它變了嗎？大小不是唯一條件。
lines.en: Of a pigmented lesion ask one thing: has it changed? Size is not the only criterion.

post.zh: 對。演變是最重要的警訊。現在去攝影區，把她去年的照片和今天的放在一起。
post.en: Right. Evolution is the most important warning sign. Now to the photo station, and put last year's photo next to today's.

guide.zh: 到攝影區比較兩張照片
guide.en: Compare the two photos at the station

lines.zh: 去年的照片：戶外、側光、沒有尺、距離不明。今天的是標準化照片：固定燈、固定距離、有尺。
lines.en: Last year's photo: outdoors, side light, no ruler, unknown distance. Today's is a standardised photograph: fixed light, fixed distance, ruler.

lines.zh: 所以不能直接比大小。但邊緣的形狀和顏色分布可以比，而且確實不一樣了。
lines.en: So the size cannot be compared directly. But the shape of the edge and the colour distribution can, and they are genuinely different.

lines.zh: 公平比較之後還是有演變，加上皮膚鏡下的可疑結構。你今天要怎麼做？
lines.en: Even after a fair comparison there is evolution, plus suspicious structures on dermoscopy. What do you do today?

q.zh: 演變明確、皮膚鏡可疑，但病人說她很忙。今天怎麼做？
q.en: Clear evolution, suspicious dermoscopy, but the patient says she is busy. What today?

options.zh: 今天切片，指定結果追蹤人與聯絡方式
options.en: Biopsy today; name a result-tracking owner and contact route

why.zh: 影像提示風險，組織才能回答。忙的病人最容易錯過追蹤，所以追蹤的人和方式今天就要定。
why.en: Imaging signals risk; only tissue answers. Busy patients are the ones who miss follow-up, so the owner and the route are set today.

options.zh: 三個月後再拍一次照看看
options.en: Re-photograph in three months and see

why.zh: 演變已經有了，再等三個月只是讓它再演變三個月。
why.en: The evolution is already there; three more months only buys three more months of evolution.

options.zh: 皮膚鏡看起來可疑，直接當惡性治療
options.en: Dermoscopy looks suspicious; treat as malignant now

why.zh: 皮膚鏡提示風險，不能分期也不能定計畫。沒有病理就沒有治療計畫。
why.en: Dermoscopy signals risk; it cannot stage or plan. No pathology, no treatment plan.

post.zh: 今天？……好。攤位我請妹妹顧。電話留我妹妹的，我常漏接。
post.en: Today? ...All right. My sister can mind the stall. Put my sister's number down; I miss calls all the time.

guide.en: Mark the biopsy margins in the procedure room

lines.zh: 先畫，再拍，再消毒。邊界標記和取樣點要讓病理醫師看得懂方向。
lines.en: Mark first, photograph, then prep. The margin marks and sampling site must let the pathologist read the orientation.

post.zh: 好。取樣完成，罐子貼雙識別。申請單上一定要有部位圖和照片，病理醫師不是在猜。
post.en: Good. Sample taken, pot labelled with two identifiers. The request form must carry a site diagram and photos; the pathologist is not guessing.

guide.en: Handle the specimen with Nurse Ting

lines.zh: 檢體從離開皮膚到進病理科，每一步都有順序。排給我看。
lines.en: From leaving the skin to arriving in pathology, every step has an order. Lay it out.

q.zh: 把皮膚切片檢體的處理順序排對
q.en: Put the skin-specimen handling steps in order

steps.zh: 床邊核對雙識別並貼罐身標籤
steps.en: Two identifiers, label the pot at the bedside

steps.zh: 申請單附部位圖、照片與臨床資訊
steps.en: Form with site diagram, photos, clinical details

steps.zh: 登錄追蹤單與結果追蹤人
steps.en: Log the tracker and the result owner

steps.zh: 送件並確認病理科簽收

post.zh: 對。追蹤人那一格是整個流程最常空著的，也是最常出事的。
post.en: Right. The owner box is the one most often left blank, and the one where things most often go wrong.

note.zh: 王伯：外觀不是組織結果
note.en: Mr Wang: appearance is not histology

guide.en: Call Mr Wang into the room

lines.zh: 醫師，這是刮鬍子刮到的，半年了而已。是我孫子一直吵。
lines.en: Doctor, this is a shaving cut, only six months old. It is my grandson who keeps nagging.

lines.zh: 王伯，同一個地方每次結痂掉了又流血，半年。刮鬍子的傷口不會這樣。
lines.en: Mr Wang, the same spot bleeding again every time the crust falls off, for six months. A shaving cut does not do that.

lines.zh: 皮膚鏡看看。邊緣像珍珠，上面有細血管。像什麼？
lines.en: Dermoscopy. A pearly border with fine vessels across it. What does that look like?

lines.zh: 像基底細胞癌。但「像」不是診斷。
lines.en: Like a basal cell carcinoma. But 'like' is not a diagnosis.

post.zh: 對。外觀可以提示，組織才能確認。今天切片，計畫等病理。
post.en: Right. Appearance suggests; tissue confirms. Biopsy today; the plan waits for pathology.

guide.zh: 到工作站看鼻翼的影像
guide.en: Review the nose images at the workstation

lines.zh: 把王伯的臨床照片和皮膚鏡影像調出來。病灶在鼻翼邊緣。為什麼計畫不能只看直徑？
lines.en: Pull up Mr Wang's clinical and dermoscopy images. The lesion sits on the nostril rim. Why can the plan not be decided by diameter alone?

question.zh: 鼻翼邊緣的小病灶，治療計畫為什麼不能只看直徑？
question.en: A small lesion on the nostril rim: why is the plan not decided by diameter alone?

answer.zh: 因為它靠近自由邊緣。切除會影響鼻孔的形狀和呼吸，重建方式要和病人重視的外觀與功能一起討論。病理確認在前，部位與目標決定計畫，直徑只是其中一項。
answer.en: Because it sits by a free margin. Excision affects the shape of the nostril and breathing, and reconstruction must be discussed with the appearance and function the patient values. Histology first; then site and goals shape the plan, with diameter only one factor.

post.zh: 醫師，鼻子會不會變形？我還要吹薩克斯風。
post.en: Doctor, will my nose change shape? I still play the saxophone.

post.zh: 這就是為什麼不能只看直徑。薩克斯風寫進計畫裡。
post.en: That is exactly why it is not just the diameter. The saxophone goes into the plan.

guide.zh: 練習：順皮紋的梭形設計
guide.en: Practice: a fusiform design along the skin lines

lines.zh: 病理回來之前先練設計。梭形切除，長軸順著皮紋，兩端夠尖才縫得平。在模型上畫。
lines.en: Practise the design while pathology is pending. A fusiform excision, long axis along the skin tension lines, ends pointed enough to close flat. Draw it on the model.

post.zh: 方向對了。真正的鼻翼不會這麼好畫，所以病理確認之後，這個部位我們會和整形外科一起討論。
post.en: Orientation right. A real nostril rim is never this easy to draw, which is why, once histology confirms, this site is discussed together with plastic surgery.

guide.zh: 寫王伯的病歷與申請單
guide.en: Write Mr Wang's note and request

lines.zh: 你寫下：半年病程、同處反覆出血結痂、皮膚鏡所見、部位靠近自由邊緣、病人重視呼吸與外觀。最後一行：吹薩克斯風。
lines.en: You write: six-month course, repeated bleeding and crusting at one site, dermoscopy findings, proximity to the free margin, the patient's priorities of breathing and appearance. Last line: plays the saxophone.

lines.zh: （經過）最後一行留著。病理醫師不需要，整形外科需要。
lines.en: (Passing) Keep the last line. The pathologist does not need it; plastic surgery does.

sub.zh: 阿香的檢體已收到；請補皮膚鏡照片與演變描述
sub.en: Ms Hsiang's specimen received; please add the dermoscopy image and the evolution history

lines.zh: 你補上：半年的演變、兩張照片的拍攝條件差異、皮膚鏡所見、邊界標記的方向。病理醫師會因為這幾行少猜很多。
lines.en: You add: six months of evolution, the difference in conditions between the two photos, the dermoscopy findings, the orientation of the margin marks. These lines spare the pathologist a great deal of guessing.

lines.zh: （經過）病理報告的品質，有一半是申請單決定的。
lines.en: (Passing) Half the quality of a pathology report is decided by the request form.

note.en: Mr Chiang: a nodule grown in six weeks

guide.en: Call Mr Chiang into the room

lines.zh: 醫師，耳朵這顆六週前還是小小的，現在會痛，偶爾流血。我想把移植的藥停掉，免得一直長。
lines.en: Doctor, this one on my ear was tiny six weeks ago; now it hurts and bleeds sometimes. I want to stop the transplant drugs so nothing else grows.

lines.zh: 阿強，移植八年的免疫抑制、三十年工地日曬、耳廓這個部位、六週變大。四件事加起來，今天就要處理。
lines.en: Mr Chiang, eight years of immunosuppression after the transplant, thirty years of sun on building sites, this site on the ear, growth within six weeks. Those four together mean we act today.

lines.zh: 快速變化讓「觀察」不再是選項。但停藥那件事，你怎麼回答他？
lines.en: Rapid change takes 'observe' off the table. But the drugs: how do you answer him?

post.zh: 阿強，移植藥不能自己停，腎臟會排斥。皮膚科和移植團隊會一起評估，調整由他們決定。今天先切片，拍整個耳朵和頸部淋巴結區。
post.en: Mr Chiang, the transplant drugs are never stopped on your own; the kidney would reject. Dermatology and the transplant team assess together and any adjustment is theirs. Today we biopsy and photograph the whole ear and the neck node areas.

post.zh: ……那顆腎是我太太給的。我不會亂停。
post.en: ...That kidney came from my wife. I will not mess with it.

post.zh: 全景、近景、皮膚鏡，三張都有尺。頸部也拍。
post.en: Overview, close-up, dermoscopy, all three with a ruler. The neck as well.

note.en: Ms Mei: not just a rash

guide.en: Take the call, run to the ER

sub.zh: 25 歲女性「一個皮疹」，吃抗生素一週，發燒
sub.en: 25-year-old woman, 'a rash', a week on antibiotics, febrile

lines.zh: 急診阿哲。25 歲女性，抗生素吃一週，昨天起全身疹，今天發燒。只是一個皮疹，可以開藥膏回家嗎？
lines.en: Che in the ER. 25-year-old woman, a week on an antibiotic, rash since yesterday, febrile today. Just a rash; can she go home with a cream?

lines.zh: 嘴巴和眼睛呢？皮膚會不會痛、有沒有水泡？
lines.en: Mouth and eyes? Is the skin painful, any blisters?

lines.zh: ……她說嘴巴破、眼睛痛。背上有幾個水泡。
lines.en: ...She says mouth ulcers and sore eyes. A few blisters on her back.

lines.zh: 你到急診。小美縮在床上，嘴唇破皮，眼睛紅，背上的皮一碰就皺起來。監視器上體溫在閃。
lines.en: You reach the ER. Ms Mei is curled on the bed, lips raw, eyes red, the skin on her back wrinkling at a touch. The temperature on the monitor flashes.

options.zh: 停可疑藥物、評估黏膜與剝離面積、升級照護、叫師傅
options.en: Stop the suspect drug, assess mucosa and detachment, escalate care, call the mentor

why.zh: 皮疹加發燒加黏膜加皮膚剝離，這是嚴重皮膚藥物不良反應。藥今天就停，照護等級今天就升，不是開藥膏。
why.en: Rash plus fever plus mucosa plus skin detachment is a severe cutaneous adverse reaction. The drug stops today and the level of care rises today; this is not a cream.

options.zh: 開止癢藥膏和退燒藥回家
options.en: Anti-itch cream and an antipyretic, home

why.zh: 回家的路上皮膚會繼續剝。這是皮膚科少數會致命的急症。
why.en: Her skin keeps peeling on the way home. This is one of dermatology's few lethal emergencies.

options.zh: 把抗生素吃完再說，感染比較重要
options.en: Finish the antibiotic first; the infection matters more

why.zh: 造成這一切的很可能就是那顆抗生素。多吃一顆，多剝一片皮。
why.en: That antibiotic is very likely the cause. One more tablet, one more sheet of skin.

post.zh: （趕到）對。嚴重皮膚藥物不良反應。停藥、記錄剝離面積、眼科會診、燒燙傷等級的照護。小美，妳不是「只是一個皮疹」。
post.en: (Arriving) Right. A severe cutaneous adverse reaction. Stop the drug, chart the detached area, ophthalmology review, burns-level care. Ms Mei, you are not 'just a rash'.

post.zh: ……我以為是過敏。我論文下週要交。
post.en: ...I thought it was an allergy. My thesis is due next week.

post.zh: 這週的工作是妳的皮膚。論文的事，我們幫妳開診斷書。
post.en: This week's work is your skin. For the thesis, we will write the medical certificate.

lines.zh: 阿香：皮膚切片今天完成，病理追蹤人是我，聯絡方式是她妹妹。王伯：切片完成，等病理再與整形外科討論。
lines.en: Ms Hsiang: skin biopsy done today, I own the pathology follow-up, contact via her sister. Mr Wang: biopsied, plastic surgery discussion once pathology is back.

lines.zh: 阿強：切片與全區照片完成，移植團隊已通知。小美：嚴重皮膚藥物不良反應，可疑藥已停，收治升級，眼科今晚看。
lines.en: Mr Chiang: biopsied with full-area photos, transplant team informed. Ms Mei: severe cutaneous adverse reaction, suspect drug stopped, admitted at an escalated level, ophthalmology tonight.

lines.zh: 阿香那條，你早上就把追蹤人和妹妹的電話定下來了。忙的病人最容易漏，你沒有讓她漏。
lines.en: For Ms Hsiang you fixed the owner and the sister's number this morning. Busy patients are the ones who slip through; you did not let her.

lines.zh: 王伯：切片完成，等病理再與整形外科討論。阿強：切片與全區照片完成，移植團隊已通知。
lines.en: Mr Wang: biopsied, plastic surgery discussion once pathology is back. Mr Chiang: biopsied with full-area photos, transplant team informed.

lines.zh: 小美：嚴重皮膚藥物不良反應，可疑藥已停，收治升級，眼科今晚看。
lines.en: Ms Mei: severe cutaneous adverse reaction, suspect drug stopped, admitted at an escalated level, ophthalmology tonight.

lines.zh: 阿香呢？早上你想三個月後再拍。我在攝影區把她叫回來切了。她妹妹的電話是小婷追著要的。你的交班單上少了一個名字。
lines.en: And Ms Hsiang? This morning you wanted to re-photograph in three months. I called her back from the photo station and biopsied her. Nurse Ting chased her sister's number. Your handover is missing a name.

lines.zh: ……阿香：切片完成，病理追蹤人是我。對不起，演變已經在那裡了，我還在看大小。
lines.en: ...Ms Hsiang: biopsied, I own the pathology follow-up. I am sorry; the evolution was right there and I was still looking at size.

guide.en: Close the photo station with Nurse Ting

lines.zh: 今天三十七組照片，每一組都有尺。三個檢體都簽收了，追蹤單上三個名字。明天我打第一通追蹤電話。
lines.en: Thirty-seven photo sets today, every one with a ruler. All three specimens signed in, three names on the tracker. I make the first follow-up call tomorrow.

lines.zh: 阿香的妹妹。
lines.en: Ms Hsiang's sister.

lines.zh: 阿香的妹妹。還有，皮膚鏡要充電，它今天真的很忙。
lines.en: Ms Hsiang's sister. And the dermatoscope goes on charge; it really was busy today.

lines.zh: 今天四個病人，四個「只是」：只是一顆痣、只是刮鬍子、只是一顆硬塊、只是一個皮疹。
lines.en: Four patients today, four 'justs': just a mole, just a shaving cut, just a hard lump, just a rash.

lines.zh: 皮膚科的全部工作，就是在「只是」後面問一句：它變了嗎？然後讓組織說話。
lines.en: The whole of dermatology is asking one question after the word 'just': has it changed? And then letting the tissue speak.

lines.zh: 師傅，我的尺貼紙用完了。
lines.en: Dr Chuang, I have run out of ruler stickers.

lines.zh: 好現象。明天再給你一捲。
lines.en: A good sign. Another roll tomorrow.

note.zh: 夜間：小美的皮膚剝離增加

guide.en: Take the call, see Ms Mei

sub.zh: 小美背上的剝離面積變大，眼睛更痛
sub.en: Ms Mei's detachment is spreading and her eyes hurt more

lines.zh: 阿哲。小美背上剝離的面積比傍晚大，眼睛更痛，體溫還高，血壓還好。燒燙傷中心的床在問要不要轉。
lines.en: Che. Ms Mei's detached area on the back is larger than this evening, her eyes hurt more, still febrile, pressure holding. The burns unit is asking whether to transfer.

lines.zh: 剝離面積每班畫圖記錄，現在重畫一次比對。眼科今晚一定要看到她。
lines.en: Chart the detached area as a diagram every shift; redraw it now and compare. Ophthalmology must see her tonight.

lines.zh: 轉燒燙傷等級照護我同意，我現在通知莊主治，依醫囑補充與傷口照護繼續。
lines.en: I agree with transfer to burns-level care; I am calling Dr Chuang now, and fluids and wound care continue per orders.

lines.zh: 醫師……我還是「只是一個皮疹」的那個嗎？
lines.en: Doctor... am I still the 'just a rash' one?

lines.zh: 妳從來都不是。今晚整間醫院都知道妳的名字。
lines.en: You never were. Tonight the whole hospital knows your name.

sub.zh: 在「只是」後面問一句：它變了嗎？
sub.en: After the word 'just', ask: has it changed?
